labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Strict Mode now re-runs effects on mount to check for restorable state, a dev-time behavior change that can expose effects that are not idempotent.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Assuming Symbols are always available raises the effective runtime requirement, so environments without Symbol support will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the object-assign polyfill means environments that relied on React to provide it must now supply it themselves.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The unstable_changedBits API is removed, so any code using it will break and must be migrated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Components can now return undefined, a behavior change that affects code previously relying on the error for undefined returns.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: useEffect resulting from discrete events is now flushed synchronously, which changes effect timing for applications.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Suspense fallback={undefined} now behaves like null instead of being ignored, changing rendered output for existing code.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: All lazy() components resolving to the same component are now treated as equivalent, which can change reconciliation and state preservation.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Console is no longer patched during first render, changing dev console output that tests or tooling may depend on.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Memory usage improvement is accurate and useful but requires no user action at this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Improved error messages for string coercion failures are informational and require no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Switching the scheduler to setImmediate when available can change scheduling behavior in environments such as jsdom or fake-timer test setups.

labels.label: noise
